title: Cancel a conditional vehicle registration
summary: Learn how to cancel your conditional vehicle registration at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you need to cancel your conditional vehicle registration, you can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

You'll receive a cancellation letter so you can apply for a refund for the unused portion of your compulsory third party (CTP) insurance.

You will not receive a refund for number plate or administration fees already paid to Transport for NSW.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the 'Cancel Registration Advice' on the back of the vehicle's Certificate of Conditional Registration.
Make sure you have all the required documents and your number plate(s).
Visit a service centre to cancel your conditional vehicle registration.

faqs.q: Will I receive a refund for all the fees I paid?
faqs.a: You will receive a cancellation letter to apply for a refund for the unused portion of your compulsory third party (CTP) insurance. However, you will not receive a refund for number plate or administration fees already paid to Transport for NSW.
